before: 0.6.0 failed the new browser-internal redirect regression with net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT
cause: manual fetch exposes an opaque redirect without a readable status or target; the cache path failed the paused native request when ordinary response headers were absent or late
fixes: Capture onBeforeRedirect for internal redirects and wait for asynchronous response metadata
Preserve earlier response Cookie headers when the redirect event has filtered headers
Clean temporary rules by extension initiator rather than numeric ID; drop bindings to closed tabs
